product_metadata.title: Umbra Zoola Ring Holder, Chrome
features: HOLDS MULTIPLE RINGS: This holder features enough room to store multiple rings of various sizes on the dog’s tail
AFFORDABLE GIFT: Great for Valentine’s Day, Birthdays, Mother’s Day, Christmas etc. , ideal for party favors
SHINY CHROME FINISH: Featuring a modern chrome finish, Zoola is easy to wipe clean and dust
COMPACT SIZE: This holder is petite and takes up very little space on a vanity, counter or tabletop, adds a variation in height to any display
description: A whimsical yet modern ring holder shaped like a Frenchie dog. Introducing Zoola Frenchie by Umbra Zoola is made of cast metal and has a shiny chrome-plated finish. The petite, yet sturdy, animal ring holder complements many interior spaces. Do not let the small size fool you - each animal ring holder can house eight or more rings. Ideal next to your bed, at the kitchen sink, or bathroom countertop. The bottom surface of each animal features a felt liner to prevent scratching. Great for Gifting The Frenchie is part of the Zoola series which also comes in a three pack. Other figurines in the series include a bunny, cat, elephant and a llama. Each Zoola measures approximately 1 ¾ x 1 ½ x 3 ″ (4. 4 x 3. 8 x 7. 6 cm). For a dash of extra charm wherever you store your jewelry, order Zoola today. About Umbra: A global product design company providing original, modern, casual, and functional design for the home.
